parameters.query:
UPDATE integracion_leads i
LEFT JOIN campaign_contacts cc ON cc.id = i.campaign_contact_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT s.client_id, s.pilot_solution_guid AS guid, s.conversation_id, s.interest_level, s.status, s.pilot_lead_id, s.error_message, s.created_at
  FROM sa_leads s
  JOIN (SELECT MAX(id) AS id FROM sa_leads WHERE pilot_solution_guid <> '' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 8 DAY GROUP BY client_id, pilot_solution_guid) m ON m.id = s.id
) s ON s.client_id = i.company_id AND s.guid COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i.external_id
SET i.entregado_at = COALESCE(cc.delivered_at, i.entregado_at),
    i.leido_at = COALESCE(cc.read_at, i.leido_at),
    i.envio_status = IF(cc.delivery_status IN ('failed','undelivered'), 'failed', i.envio_status),
    i.envio_reason = IF(cc.delivery_status IN ('failed','undelivered'), NULLIF(cc.error_message, ''), i.envio_reason),
    i.contesto = IF(cc.button_clicked IS NOT NULL OR s.conversation_id IS NOT NULL, 1, i.contesto),
    i.contesto_at = IF(i.contesto_at IS NULL AND (cc.button_clicked IS NOT NULL OR s.conversation_id IS NOT NULL), COALESCE(s.created_at, NOW()), i.contesto_at),
    i.boton_respuesta = IF(cc.button_clicked IS NOT NULL AND cc.button_clicked <> '', LEFT(IF(JSON_VALID(cc.button_clicked), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.button_clicked, '$.button_title')), cc.button_clicked), 100), i.boton_respuesta),
    i.conversation_id = COALESCE(s.conversation_id, i.conversation_id),
    i.grado_interes = CASE
      WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(i.extra, '$.grado_interes_fuente') IS NOT NULL THEN i.grado_interes
      WHEN NULLIF(s.interest_level, 'unknown') IS NOT NULL THEN s.interest_level
      WHEN cc.button_clicked IS NOT NULL AND cc.button_clicked <> '' AND IF(JSON_VALID(cc.button_clicked), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.button_clicked, '$.button_title')), cc.button_clicked) LIKE 'No%' THEN 'cold'
      WHEN i.contesto = 0 AND (cc.button_clicked IS NULL OR cc.button_clicked = '') AND s.conversation_id IS NULL AND i.enviado_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR THEN 'cold'
      ELSE i.grado_interes END,
    i.crm_lead_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.pilot_lead_id, ''), i.crm_lead_id),
    i.crm_status = COALESCE(s.status, i.crm_status),
    i.crm_reason = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.error_message, ''), i.crm_reason)
WHERE i.status = 'enviado' AND i.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

nodes.name: Errores de envío = Frío

parameters.query:
UPDATE integracion_leads
SET grado_interes = 'cold'
WHERE company_id IN (133, 199)
  AND integracion IN ('vento_webhook', 'megamoto_webhook')
  AND id NOT IN (8, 9, 10, 11, 134, 135, 136, 137)
  AND grado_interes IS NULL
  AND contesto = 0
  AND (status = 'failed' OR (status = 'enviado' AND envio_status = 'failed'))

nodes.notes: Solo Vento (133) y MEGAMOTO (199): si el mensaje no salió o no se entregó, el lead queda Frío (regla de Víctor).
